Self.Wiki: Particle effect point: plays the SFX Effect ID at its position.

EffectID.Wiki: The SFX ID this emitter produces.

StartDisabled.Wiki: If ON, this particle will be inactive until it is enabled via an event script.

UnkT05.Wiki: A flag read as a byte. The effect creation copies it into the SFX control (FXHGSfxCtrl +406h); its effect is not known. 0 in every retail SFX.
